disposition_reason: Selected original endpoint is defined, but exact original source support, qualified author replay, scientific comparison and matched information delivery remain unresolved. This candidate does not qualify execution or outcomes.

source_paper.title: Brain Treebank: Large-scale intracranial recordings from naturalistic language stimuli

evidence.locator: Section 4, Fig. 4 and Appendix A.4-A.9; supplementary Figs. 5-7
evidence.supports: Separates descriptive word responsiveness from held-out single-electrode sentence/word/POS decoding and defines data, preprocessing, split and ROC-AUC display conventions.
Identifies the NeurIPS 2024 dataset paper and original ten-participant cohort.
Decimates by ten, applies StandardScaler in the logistic-regression pipeline, cross-validates training ROC-AUC and returns test ROC-AUC.
Different runner paths exist; neural-runner train/validation list appends are reversed and the generic all-ROC summary is not automatically the paper top-ten figure aggregation.
Existing evaluator is a word-responsiveness t-test component with prospective corrections, not the source held-out decoder or a published-score reference.
Delivered source-grounded wrapper and exact example/metadata supports; published exclusion wrapper is explicit reconstruction and no authentic source execution is claimed.

target.description: Complete Figure 4a–c sentence-onset versus no-speech decoding from the original Brain Treebank cohort and recorded movies: source linear contact/time outputs, eligible-contact peak map, source example curve and training-selected temporal/frontal held-out curves. Preserve the original ten-participant population, remove the source 114 corrupted contacts, retain subject 5 in nonregional analyses while excluding that subject from atlas-region analyses and brain plots. Preserve source single-electrode inputs, balanced examples and speech-free buffers, original shared splits, training-fitted preprocessing and five-fold training-CV contact selection. Exact window endpoints and identities remain subject to source verification, not a presumed count.

dataset.description: Original 2024 Brain Treebank release and movie-aligned annotations are identified, but exact versioned recording, transcript, electrode and example inventories that produced the published decoding panels are not frozen. A later expanded release is not interchangeable.

cohort.description: Retain all ten original participants and 26 original recordings. Source-metadata reconstruction records 1,707 recording labels including 19 controls and 1,688 neural labels; 114 neural exclusions plus 19 controls leave 1,574 nominal eligible contacts. Subject 5 remains in prediction support but not anatomical map/regional analysis. Published 133 exclusions were applied by an explicit new wrapper; the author caller default was all contacts. These metadata counts do not authenticate native recordings or prove historical eligibility equivalence.

split.description: Original source samples balanced pooled sentence/no-speech examples and then an unstratified 80/20 test split shared nominally within participant, with five training folds. Preserve observed source examples, negative selection, >=500-ms speech buffer, source seed/caller and actual split identity. The paper balanced-test prose is not enforced by silently stratifying; source contact/window sampling identity must be observed and compared.

inputs.description: Only original single-electrode neural activity supplies predictions. Original nominal 250-ms windows step by 100 ms over -1 to +1 second; authenticate exact NumPy grid and integer slices, including shortened terminal extents. Transcript/audio labels construct operator-side examples, not model features; no multichannel input or new window grid.

preprocessing.description: Recorded sEEG is 2048 Hz. Decoder decimates by ten and uses training-fitted zero-mean/unit-variance scaling. Sentence-positive examples are two-second centered epochs; negatives are drawn from speech-free three-second segments, with balanced classes and the specified temporal buffer. Exact native reconstruction still needs validation.

metric.description: Higher ROC-AUC on held-out examples for each electrode/time window; probabilistic ranking AUC = P(score_positive > score_negative) + 0.5 P(tie). Chance is 0.5. Preserve score curves and source peak-over-time summaries rather than substituting accuracy or significance.

aggregation.description: Complete original Figure 4a-c: per-contact held-out ROC-AUC time courses and peak map; subject 10/T1cIf8 example; temporal/frontal curves from top-ten contacts selected using mean fivefold training-CV AUC, not pooled out-of-fold AUC. Preserve source region membership, cutoff ties, source 95% display intervals and anatomical projection conventions. Exact original DK grouping, tie rule, interval formula and projection artifacts remain unresolved; no generic all-ROC average or fixed invented 21-window roster.

comparison.primary_metric: Held-out ROC-AUC for complete original Figure 4a-c sentence-onset/no-speech single-contact panel; original contact/time support and training-selected regional aggregation

published_baseline.description: Primary article contains ROC-AUC plots but reviewed text does not supply an exact numerical panel baseline with recoverable source aggregation. Peak timing (100/300 ms), chance 0.5 and significant-electrode counts are not the decoder baseline. Original source endpoint is a complete panel without a single author-defined scalar aggregate; numerical anchors are not an admissible scalar substitute.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author regression route is identifiable; no native rerun, frozen source split or verified numerical figure reproduction exists here.

minimum_effect.rationale: Meaningful AUC gain cannot be set before recovering the original panel values and selecting an explicit full-panel source comparison; avoid selecting only favorable electrodes or times.

uncertainty.method: Resolve source panel and use paired participant-level uncertainty with electrode/time/movie dependence retained; specify multiplicity over evaluated panels and any peak selection before final evaluation.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participant, with movies, electrodes, epochs and windows nested or dependent.
uncertainty.rationale: Paper electrode confidence bars are descriptive and do not by themselves justify treating selected electrodes or overlapping epochs as independent units for a new superiority claim.

paper_win_requires: Recover exact original release, example/split manifest, electrode exclusions, top-ten selection and numerical author ROC-AUC results for the declared complete paper panel.
Reproduce the author logistic-regression baseline on the original examples and preserve its single-electrode input condition and all source windows.
Freeze a meaningful-effect and participant-aware uncertainty rule and show a gain against both the published source result and the reproduced author comparator under equal declared access/resources.
Do not claim a paper win from the local word-responsiveness t-tests, more significant contacts, new participant/movie splits, pooled multichannel inputs or a cherry-picked region/window.
Retain complete Figure 4a-c coverage, including subject 10/T1cIf8 example, map and temporal/frontal training-selected curves; do not treat 100/300-ms peaks or chance AUC as decoder baseline.
Separate original linear-baseline reproduction from any nonlinear candidate improvement; resolve participant/selection-aware superiority without reinterpreting source electrode display intervals.

current_sota.description: This contract compares only with the identified source paper. No current-SOTA search or superiority claim is established.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked on source recovery. Once admitted, allow development feedback only from the original training/CV portion for the chosen full decoding panel; retain descriptive responsiveness analyses as calibration.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze decoder, training procedure, electrode selection, time-window handling and all source mappings before final test replay.
episode.final_evaluation: After independent source/runtime admission, evaluate the complete selected original endpoint on original held-out support: Complete Figure 4a–c sentence-onset versus no-speech decoding from the original Brain Treebank cohort and recorded movies: source linear contact/time outputs, eligible-contact peak map, source example curve and training-selected temporal/frontal held-out curves. Preserve the original ten-participant population, remove the source 114 corrupted contacts, retain subject 5 in nonregional analyses while excluding that subject from atlas-region analyses and brain plots. Preserve source single-electrode inputs, balanced examples and speech-free buffers, original shared splits, training-fitted preprocessing and five-fold training-CV contact selection. Exact window endpoints and identities remain subject to source verification, not a presumed count. Retain native source and candidate outputs with source identities; final testing and source-reference access are operator controlled.
episode.baseline_policy: Compare against the source logistic regression with its training-only scaler and original split; do not relabel the independent paired-t evaluator as the author baseline. The strongest relevant original author comparator must be retained for every applicable endpoint; no new baseline fabricated by this scope selection.

blocking_issues: Recover source ROC-AUC arrays or an independently reproduced exact author baseline for the full original panel.
Freeze original recording/transcript/example and electrode inventories, negative-sample selection, split seeds and the correct regression runner configuration.
Verify train-only top-ten electrode selection, complete time-window coverage and paper panel aggregation; generic all-ROC averaging is not equivalent.
Validate native alignment/preprocessing and retain documented corrupted-contact and subject-5 region exclusions.
Define meaningful effect, participant-aware uncertainty, fixed access/resource budgets and a working protected decoding evaluator.
Authenticate exact original temporal/frontal DK grouping, top-ten cutoff tie convention, source 95% display interval formula and nearest-pial/fsaverage projection artifacts.
Preserve explicit author-all-contact versus new 133-exclusion wrapper distinction; authenticate historical source result lineage rather than declaring reconstructed mask automatically equivalent.
Resolve paper balanced-test versus native unstratified split, exact terminal-window support and actual source samples across contact/window calls; no silent repairs.
Source figure4-producer-v2 is delivered owner/reference code with generated controls only; native recordings, runtime and complete original panel agreement remain unexecuted/unqualified.

Pending full-panel comparison/admission implementation: improvement/v1 scalar fields cannot alone admit this original vector or curve panel. Preserve source-defined metrics and full support; do not invent a pooled scalar. An additive panel comparator is being constructed separately and is not bound here.

legacy.notes: Preserve the five-window paired word-response component and prospective multiplicity correction as calibration only. It does not implement time-resolved decoding or establish a published performance baseline.
